changelog: The Mac build covers 0.0.108 and 0.0.109. Starting a new campaign now asks first when you have one in progress, and points you to Resume, so a tap on your general no longer wipes a saved run. Resuming a Daily Commission no longer counts its starting medals into your collection again. Battle tips were rewritten around a first-time player: the opening fight teaches only what it takes to win it -- unit, move, attack, card, end turn -- and danger zones, terrain and inspection wait for the second battle. Tips are one or two sentences, sit under the top bar clear of the board and your hand, replace each other after a few seconds instead of waiting for a click, never appear during the enemy turn, and there is a Skip tips button. Each run's first Act I skirmish at Ascension 0 is now a plain destroy-them fight on known ground. Incoming-damage badges are dashed and see-through, so a forecast no longer reads as damage already taken. In the demo, first launch goes straight into the opening fight, and the menu shows the full game's commanders and features as locked tiles that explain what the full version adds. Mac: universal (Apple Silicon and Intel), Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Minimum macOS 11. Controller support is confirmed working on the Mac. 1,316 tests.
